response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS a FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY eventannotm), b AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS base FROM g WHERE a IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(g.a) AS mean_of_above_group_averages, AVG(g.a - b.base) AS mean_excess_over_baseline FROM g CROSS JOIN b WHERE g.a > b.base

assumptions.assumption: Groups whose average is NULL (all instownpct missing) are excluded from the baseline, since they have no average to count; they also can't exceed the baseline.
The NULL eventannotm forms its own group via GROUP BY, as requested.
